title: Water–cement ratio and concrete strength
intro: A ready-mix supplier cast ten batches of concrete with water–cement ratios from 0.40 to 0.65 and tested a cylinder from each at 28 days. x is the water–cement ratio (kg of water per kg of cement) and y is the compressive strength (MPa). More water makes weaker concrete, so expect a falling pattern. Read the correlation r, R² and the fitted line.
